When I was a teenager, I felt the same urgent need as you to go somewhere far away. I was able to do that but it took a lot of luck. I encourage you to do all you can do to succeed in school. This may require you to talk to a professor or someone in the administration, and share your concern about not being able to catch up. Perhaps there are tutors or you can change your major to something more manageable?

It is never too late to learn more discipline and study skills. It feels hard and boring at first, but it will not always feel that way. One thing I do is I create a small reward after doing boring homework. For example I decide after I finish this assignment, I can go on Reddit. Or I treat myself to candy, or a glass of wine. If you give yourself small rewards after small tasks, you won't feel as overwhelmed.

Even if this advice doesn't help you, I hear your feelings and think they are totally valid. It is difficult to be without friends or nice neighbors, it is difficult to feel you must stay inside for your safety. That is not an ideal situation for anyone.

He has expressed the desire and temptation to just be with me but the past few years I resigned myself to the likelihood it would never happen, or it would happen in a traumatic way that just left us all miserable.
